title: Development card sort, 12 cards
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y9 lesson 14 (Development card sort, 12 cards (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 14: An unequal world: what is development?. To understand what development means and how it differs across the world

cards:
development
improving people's lives,
wealth and wellbeing

inequality
big differences between people
or places

poverty
not having enough to meet
basic needs

quality of life
how good people's lives are

standard of living
people's wealth and the goods
they can buy
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.q: Explain the difference between standard of living and quality of life.
questions.a: Standard of living is about wealth and goods (1); quality of life includes health, safety, happiness and freedom (1)
questions.model: Standard: money and things. Quality: wider wellbeing. One is part of the other.

questions.q: Sort 12 development cards into economic, social and environmental, then rank your top five for a good life and justify the top one.
questions.model: Teacher sorts the first three cards.

questions.q: In the portal response box, explain why development is hard to measure with one number.
questions.a: It has many dimensions; averages hide inequality

questions.q: Can a country develop too fast? Explain.
questions.a: Possible environmental damage and growing inequality
Big differences between people or places
options: Big differences between people or places

questions.q: Big question: is a rich country always developed?
questions.a: No: development also depends on health, education, rights and how fairly wealth is shared
